Your Healing Potions grant a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} second.

You gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction while you have a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} and may drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.
